Context.dev offers Developer ($20/mo), Pro ($90/mo), Growth ($300/mo), Scale ($500/mo), and Scale 2.5M ($950/mo), plus Enterprise for teams that need more than 2.5M credits a month, volume discounts, or security and procurement support. We currently do not support one-time lookups, however you can contact us to discuss options for one-time projects at hello@context.dev.
